[[Tempered Glass Vial]]s are a rare crafting material used in the crafting of Canthan elementalist auras, [[spectacles]] and [[Vial of Ink|Vials of Ink]]. 

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Tempered Glass Vial for 5 [[Pile of Glittering Dust|Piles of Glittering Dust]] and 20 {{gold}}.
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Tempered Glass Vials.
** See [[:Category:Contains tempered glass]] for other items.
* Possible drop from [[Hidden Treasure]]s revealed with [[Light of Deldrimor]].
* No [[creature]]s currently [[drop]] Tempered Glass Vials.
